# desktop-media — the KDE workstation media stack

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Distro | Arch/CachyOS (`pac` only) |
| Requires | `@github.com/opencharly/pod-pipewire` — the PipeWire server the ALSA bridge routes through |
| Service | none (packages only) |

## What it installs

The CachyOS netinstall "desktop integration" + "audio" subgroups: the
GStreamer plugin set (`gst-libav`, `gst-plugins-bad`,
`gst-plugins-ugly`, `gst-plugin-va`, `gst-plugin-pipewire`) so Plasma,
Phonon and Haruna play every codec; the VLC plugin bundle
(`vlc-plugins-all`) and DVD CSS (`libdvdcss`); thumbnailer support
(`ffmpegthumbnailer`, `libgsf`, `libopenraw`, `poppler-glib`); and the
ALSA↔PipeWire bridge (`alsa-utils`, `alsa-plugins`, `pipewire-alsa`)
with the `pavucontrol` mixer UI.

Host-firmware entries (`alsa-firmware`, `sof-firmware`) are deliberately
excluded — the streamed VM has no physical audio hardware; its sinks
come from PipeWire.

## Usage

Compose it into a KDE/Plasma workstation box:

```yaml
kde-workstation:
  candy:
    base: cachyos-base
    candy:
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-desktop-media:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
```

## Verification

`plan:` `check:` steps assert the codec/plugin artifacts on the built
image: the `gst-libav` package and its `libgstlibav.so`, the VA-API
`libgstva.so`, the `pipewire-alsa` package and its
`/etc/alsa/conf.d/99-pipewire-default.conf` drop-in, and the
`pavucontrol` / `ffmpegthumbnailer` binaries.
